notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
V 1.0.3

+ Improved connection time to matches.
+ Improved connection stability.
+ Integrity of players input better preserved over poor network conditions.
+ People with bad network connections given more time to recover before forced disconnect. 
+ Fixed issues with  Sweet Tony's presentation.
+ Fixed potential exploit in which a cloned player could connect multiple times.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 + Hotfix
notes.content:
v 1.0.2

+ The SovietAPI backend has been updated to better handle cases where high player surges or datacenter failure happens. The SovietAPI database storing data has also been upgraded and improved in scaling leading to faster matchmaking times to open lobbies. 

+Auto region finding reimplemented to work faster and with more safety in the results. Now, we scatter how our datacenters are pinged so two regions that are incredibly close aren't pinged at the same time giving ineffective results.

+Server connections now respect the timeout the server expects rather than trying to brute it's way through to be faster. This ensures server connection failures are for a good reason and prevents players from creating multiple connections.

+If a match is not available, more time is given to allow game servers to propagate up in the region instead of calling it quits quickly.

+Fixed an error that prevented the hammer and sickles from being hammers and sickles.

With these updates we hope to address the issues where players could be permanently stuck matchmaking, the issue where certain players would have a hard time finding a region or not connecting to their nearest region. 

Overall we hope that matchmaking will be much more reliable for you! 

HOTFIX - 8/4

- Potential fix to prevent phantoms from being created.
- Removed restriction to 3 player limit in party mode. 
- Bee Hive can now explode more breakable bricks. 
- Tweak to Vodka powerups bouncing behavior.

A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Removed a frame of input latency caused by an order of execution oversight
[*] Upgraded to Unity 2019.3 to resolve increased input lag while Vsync is enabled
[*] Adjusted the drop rate of items from question mark blocks
[*] Adjusted the tolerance for validating player on player stomps
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed a small visual bug in customize menu
[*] Movement for players with a high ping should be visually smoother
[*] Temporarily disabled obfuscation to fix capitalist corner 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Coins now instantly respond when picked up, regardless of ping
[*] Prediction employed for enemies to improve networked interactions
[*] Fixed dropping sound on donut blocks
[*] Taunts now clearly labeled as such in the warehouse
[*] “Host Again” button now replaces “Play Again” button after a private match
[*] Failsafes added to ensure private match servers shut down if a match is in progress with no active connections
[*] “Unlocked Only” button now works across all categories of the customize menu
[*] Taunts and palettes for characters in warehouse no longer get lost while moving between menus
[*] Unlocked only/warehouse buttons no longer prevents players from moving back while in the effect category
[*] Added proper crediting for all third party licenses 
[*] Added obfuscation to assemblies
[*] Attempting to purchase a voucher without any jump coins now redirects players to jump coin menu
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Player deceleration behaviour is now consistent regardless of held sprint button
[*] Hitting blocks now prioritizes full item boxes over breakable bricks
[*] Players joining a match should now properly initialize opponent powerup visuals
[*] Added a small delay to hitbox deactivation when hitting blocks to resolve minor mis-predictions
[*] Reworked camera logic
[*] Improved matchmaking logic
[*] Resolved bug where options menu would unexpectedly open in-game
[*] Restored snow to mountain biome
[*] Fixed culling between sewer and bunker biomes
[*] Fixed crusher placement in bunker biome
[*] Added new logic to title screen background scrolling
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Increased performance of environment shaders
[*] Introduced tilemap renderer culling for foreground tilemaps
[*] Improved reliability of pipe events
[*] Resolved round state not updating correctly after players disconnect before death
[*] Application version check now included during authentication
[*] Resolved various input bugs
[*] Added various new UI elements to improve the clarity of menu navigation
[*] Scaled gym waiting duration with respect to current playerbase size
[*] Fixed various visual inconsistencies in map
[*] Temporarily disabled death coins
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A new version of [i]Soviet Jump Game[/i] is now available. This update includes the following:

[list]
[*] Players using vodka will no longer prevent other players from passing through them
[*] Capped coins dropped on death for performance reasons
[*] Picking up a second bottle of Vodka will now reset the timer
[*] All bushes in the Mountain biome should now properly obscure players
[*] All crushers in the Bunker biome should now close with a 1 unit gap
[*] DLC packages should auto-initialize more reliably
[*] Fixed a small missing animation on crabs
[*] Input for menus has been overhauled to ensure it can’t be overwritten
[*] Small text fixes in UI
[*] System mouse cursor is now hidden
[/list]

notes.title: LET THE GAMES BEGIN!
notes.content:
Hello Jumpers! 

Thanks for all of your excitement and interest in Soviet Jump Game! We're excited to finally be able to share it with you and not make you wait to play.

We are working to get European and Australian servers up ASAP. We're hoping they will be up today or tomorrow. 

If you run into any bugs please report them to us in [url=https://forms.gle/ZSfXwibCuJrHPUcv5]our official bug reports form[/url]or on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072710/discussions/1/]our steam technical support page[/url], it'll help us fix them quicker. 

And if you want to be a part of our community you can join the official discord [url=https://discord.gg/Z2zEkS8]HERE[/url].

Thanks!
Fantastic Passion
